approaches.title: Find the common binary prefix
approaches.summary: Determine the bits shared by all numbers in the inclusive range by identifying the common leading prefix of the endpoints. The initial implementation is incorrect because it uses the endpoint intersection rather than directly comparing corresponding bits.

revisions.rawCommitSubject: rust 201!: rly thought this would work
revisions.shortChangeSummary: Initial attempt uses leading-zero counts and the endpoint bitwise intersection to construct the shared prefix; it is marked wrong.

revisions.commitComment: got a hint to track the first difference instead
revisions.rawCommitSubject: rust 201: got a hint to track the first difference instead
revisions.shortChangeSummary: Corrects the prefix detection by comparing corresponding bits of the left and right endpoints and stopping at their first difference.

revisions.commitComment: simplier way to find common most sig bits
revisions.rawCommitSubject: rust 201: simplier way to find common most sig bits
revisions.shortChangeSummary: Simplifies the same common-prefix strategy by repeatedly right-shifting both endpoints until they match, then restoring the discarded bit positions.
